en: Hover a line for details. C - close
Raw power and toughness. More health, harder hits that push enemies farther, less damage taken, more carry weight, and sprinting, dashing and attacking tire you less.
Speed and reflexes. You attack and move faster, and enemies miss you more often.
Arcane power. Stronger spells, more mana and a bit more damage.
Locked: your magic has not awakened yet. It cannot be raised and gives no mana.
Sharp eyes. More critical hits, a wider light around you, more of the map revealed, and you spot monsters and traps from farther away.
Fortune. It does nothing yet; its effects come later.
Later: judging the value of items and learning spells.

Tap Space: a short dash where you face (where you walk, or toward the mouse when standing). Passes through enemies, walls stop it. Costs {cost} exhaustion, then {cooldown} s to wait; not while exhausted. You can attack during the dash. Hold Space to charge (you stand still and tire, {charge} exhaustion per second until full): release for a long dash ({min}x to {max}x as far), or attack while holding for a dash attack that hits everything on the way ({damage_min}x to {damage_max}x damage). Agility: every dash goes {agility}% farther and the dash attack hits {agility}% harder per point.
